subject: Quick alignment: Brightlane inference priorities & proposed next step
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jay Rosen <jay@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-12-01T14:05:00Z
Subject: Quick alignment: Brightlane inference priorities & proposed next step

Hi Jay —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and a suggested next step so we keep momentum: 

- Top priority you mentioned: reduce NER latency for live ingestion (95th pct target ~120ms) while keeping quality steady.
- Current constraints: batch window limited, can't re-architect pipeline before Q2, procurement needs rough TCO and a simple SOW.
- Proposed short next step: 30-minute technical deep-dive with our runtime lead + a one-page SOW draft for procurement to review.

I attached a 1-page summary of today's discovery (Redwood-Discovery-Recap.pdf) — it calls out the latency targets, expected throughput, and an initial integration checklist. If that looks good I can share a short SOW and propose times for a follow-up next week.

Would you rather I loop in procurement now or send the SOW to you first?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0182

Attachment: Redwood-Discovery-Recap.pdf (pdf, 420 KB)

Hi Jay —

Just nudging this thread in case it got buried — did you get a chance to review the recap?

If you're still interested, quick options:
- I can send a one-page SOW draft to your procurement team now;
- Or I can schedule the 30-min tech deep-dive (our runtime lead can demo a similar 95th-pct latency setup).

Either works on our side — what do you prefer?

Thanks — no rush, just want to make this easy to evaluate.

Best,
Evelyn

From: Jay Rosen <jay@brightlane.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-12-10T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick alignment: Brightlane inference priorities & proposed next step

Hi Evelyn —

Apologies for the delay — it was a hectic week. Appreciate the concise recap. A couple quick things from our side: 

1) Procurement will want a short SOW (1 page) and a ballpark TCO for a pilot (2-3 weeks, up to 3 GPUs). Can you include estimated token costs and any minimum commitments?
2) From the engineering side, we'd like to see an outline of the integration points (how we stream events, auth, and where KV caching would live).

If you can send a draft SOW and a couple of calendar options for next week, I can loop in procurement and our infra lead (procurement@brightlane.ai, infra@brightlane.ai).

Thanks — happy to hop on a call once we have the draft.

—Jay
Head of Data Platforms | Brightlane Analytics
jay@brightlane.ai | (212) 555-0170

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jay Rosen <jay@brightlane.ai>, procurement@brightlane.ai
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-12-11T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick alignment: Brightlane inference priorities & proposed next step

Thanks Jay — great, that helps. Attached is a short SOW draft (SOW-Brightlane-Draft-v1.docx) and a 1-slide TCO summary included in the recap PDF. The SOW includes a pilot scope (2–3 weeks, up to 3x A10G equiv), acceptance criteria (95th pct latency goal), and optional procurement-friendly terms — no long-term commitment required to run the pilot.

I also pasted a brief integration checklist below to accelerate the infra review: 
- Event stream endpoint (we support Kafka/HTTP webhooks)
- Auth: mTLS or API key, with option to use customer-managed KMS for keys
- KV cache: recommend colocated cache in the same VPC subnet (we can demo prefix caching live)

Can we lock in 30 minutes next Tue or Wed? Here are a couple of slots: 
- Tue 12/16 11:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 12/17 09:00–09:30 PT

If neither works, pick a time at: https://calendly.com/evelyn-hart/30min and I'll invite the right folks.

Looping Aditya (our solutions lead) and Monica (technical PM) for the demo and SOW details.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: SOW-Brightlane-Draft-v1.docx (docx, 58 KB); Redwood-Discovery-Recap.pdf (pdf, 420 KB)
